Job Title: Associate Medical Records Collector
 Industry: US Healthcare Operations
 Job Location: Chennai 
 Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Shift: US Night Shift
 Experience: Freshers candidates are welcome
 
 Position Summary We are looking for detail-oriented and motivated individuals to join our Medical Records Retrieval team. The role involves requesting, retrieving, tracking, processing, and organizing medical records from healthcare providers across the United States to support healthcare and insurance-related operations. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, basic computer knowledge, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment while adhering to client requirements and data confidentiality standards. Key Responsibilities Request, retrieve, process, track, and organize medical records from hospitals, clinics, physician offices, and other healthcare providers across the United States. Perform request logging, case assignment, record retrieval, follow-ups, and invoicing follow-ups as per established process guidelines. Retrieve medical records through fax, email, mail, secure electronic medical record portals, and other authorized channels. Review and verify medical records and supporting documents for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements. Follow up with healthcare providers to obtain pending medical records and resolve delays in retrieval. Maintain accurate records of requests, follow-up activities, case status, and retrieval outcomes in the designated systems. Perform quality checks to minimize errors and ensure that retrieved documents meet the required standards. Prioritize daily workloads and process urgent requests within defined turnaround times. Coordinate with internal teams and healthcare providers to resolve routine issues related to medical record requests, retrieval, and documentation.
 
 Communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders through email and other approved communication channels. Follow HIPAA-related requirements, confidentiality policies, information security guidelines, and applicable client procedures when handling sensitive medical information. Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround-time targets.
 
 Candidate Profile 
 
 Any graduate from a recognized university. Freshers are welcome to apply. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with email, MS Office, and data entry. Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle repetitive tasks accurately. Good organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills. Ability to identify missing information, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when required. Willingness to learn new systems, tools, and process guidelines. Positive attitude, teamwork, adaptability, and a customer-focused approach. Must be willing to work in a US-aligned night shift and from the office. What We Offer Opportunity to begin a career in the US healthcare industry. Structured process training and guidance for freshers. Exposure to US healthcare documentation and medical records operations. Opportunities for career growth based on performance and business requirements.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ASSOCIATE III
description:
Job Summary The Customer Service Team will be supporting all transactional tasks of the TE Order-to-Cash Process playing a key role in the whole business success. The team will support the whole North America Customer Service Organization in the background. Under general supervision, the Associate is responsible for handling accurately all defined transactional tasks which are handled in the Customer Service Team. In addition, the Associate needs to support a variety of ad hoc requests to support the business in the best possible way and as required. Furthermore, the Associate is highly responsible for delivering all given tasks of 100% quality. Responsibilities Communicate effectively with international internal customers in English. Perform manual order entry, changes, and scheduling agreement updates. Handle quote entries and process credits, debits, pro forma invoices, and returns. Manage customer portals and support Electronic Data Interchange (EDI). Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer profiles. Monitor and assign tasks from the Customer Service mailbox Respond to ad hoc requests to support North America Customer Service Teams. Gain understanding of other transactional tasks served by the team. Ensure consistent use of Standard Work Instructions and Customer Profiles for every transaction. Promptly pick new orders/requests from group mailbox to support process efficiency. Ensure high quality and on-time delivery of all tasks. Demonstrate willingness to learn new tasks as per evolving business needs. Ensure constant usage of Leader Standard Work. Actively participate in daily Performance Improvement Meetings (PIM). Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (Kaizen, Green Belt, Lean). Drive TEOA in alignment with Star Level requirements. Qualifications / Experience Graduation in any stream. Minimum 3-4 years of experience in a Customer Service environment, specifically in the Order Management domain. Hands-on experience with SAP is preferred. Skills and Competencies Proficient in Outlook, SAP, MS Office (Excel, Access), SFDC and Web Portals. Excellent written and verbal communication skills Performance-oriented and quality-focused Strong team player and collaborator Highly motivated and adaptable Willingness to work in night shift (7.00 PM to 4.00 AM) Quick learner with a proactive mindset
